title: Services that ship results, not slides.
subtitle: Six focused offerings, each built around outcomes you can measure: faster pages, higher conversion, and software that doesn't crumble at scale.

items.title: Frontend Engineering
items.tagline: Interfaces that feel like silk and load like lightning.
items.description: I build pixel-perfect, fully responsive interfaces with React, Next.js, and Tailwind. Component systems, animations, accessibility — engineered so the brand feels premium on every device.
deliverables: WCAG-AA accessibility baked in from day one

items.title: Backend & API Engineering
items.tagline: REST and GraphQL that scale past the launch-day spike.
items.description: Robust Node.js and Express services with thoughtful schemas, predictable error handling, and benchmarked endpoints. I ship APIs you can actually trust on launch day.
deliverables: REST + GraphQL APIs with input validation
JWT, OAuth, and role-based access control
Caching with Redis and edge runtimes

items.title: Immersive 3D Web
items.tagline: WebGL experiences that turn visitors into believers.
items.description: React Three Fiber, Three.js, and clever shader work — from product configurators to scroll-driven cinematic stories. All without melting laptops.
deliverables: React Three Fiber scenes with Drei helpers
Mobile fallbacks that still look premium

items.title: Full-Stack Product Builds
items.tagline: End-to-end product, not just a polished screen.
items.description: From idea napkin to deployed v1. Auth, billing, dashboards, admin tools, observability — I own the whole stack so your team can focus on customers.
deliverables: From spec to production in weeks, not quarters

items.title: Performance & SEO Audits
items.tagline: Find the bottlenecks. Fix them. Watch rankings climb.
items.description: A surgical look at Core Web Vitals, bundle weight, render paths, and on-page SEO. You get a prioritized fix list with engineering effort and expected impact.
deliverables: Pre/post benchmark report you can share

items.title: Consulting & Code Mentoring
items.tagline: A senior pair-programmer for your sharpest problems.
items.description: Pair sessions, architecture reviews, hiring help, or just an honest second opinion. Bring your messiest pull request — we'll untangle it together.

process.title: Discover
process.body: We map the goal, the users, and the constraints. No code yet, just clarity.

process.title: Design
process.body: Wireframes, motion notes, and architecture diagrams everyone can argue with — in a good way.

process.title: Develop
process.body: Short, demo-friendly sprints. You see real product every week, not a black box.

process.title: Deploy
process.body: CI/CD, observability, and a launch plan. Coffee, then we ship.

process.title: Refine
process.body: Real-user telemetry, A/B tests, and iteration. The launch is the start, not the finish.
